package.name: dtp_msgs
package.description: Custom message types for the SUPER human detect-track-predict-follow feature (dtp-imp branch): Target / TargetArray (published on /dtp/targets by perception_node) and GoalStatus (published on /planning/goal_status by SUPER's fsm_node). Kept as its own package, separate from mars_uav_sim/mars_quadrotor_msgs, per plan/dtp-imp/01 SS2 "Message ownership" -- these are new DTP types and must not redefine SUPER's existing PositionCommand / MpcPositionCommand / PolynomialTrajectory.
